sources.name: Taste Skill
sources.notes: Design directions, palettes, type pairings, hero and section blueprints, motion recipes, site studies, photo-set metadata, app-screen library, and reference essays.

sources.name: Awesome DESIGN.md
sources.notes: 84 brand design-system analyses with YAML tokens. Brand names are used as references with attribution; no logos or screenshots are redistributed.

sources.name: Vercel Web Interface Guidelines
sources.notes: The audit rubric: accessibility, focus, forms, animation, typography, content handling, images, performance, navigation, touch, layout, dark mode, i18n, hydration, hover, copy, and anti-patterns.

sources.name: Playwright CLI
sources.notes: Browser automation and session-management guidance for the audit loop. The TastePro audit implementation is original; this source informs the workflow and reference skill.

sources.name: GOV.UK Design System
sources.notes: Form and service patterns. Repository code is MIT; the published guidance is OGL-3.0. Images, Crown marks, and Nunjucks examples are excluded.

sources.name: USWDS
sources.notes: Identity and complex-form patterns. CC0; linked third-party fonts, icons, and agency marks are excluded.

sources.name: CMS Design System
sources.notes: Medicare/Medicaid component and pattern guidance. CC0 with third-party font/icon exceptions; only text guidance is ingested.

sources.name: NHS.UK Design System
sources.notes: Healthcare service patterns. Repository code is MIT; the published guidance is OGL-3.0. NHS marks, Frutiger, images, and design examples are excluded.

sources.name: IBM Carbon
sources.notes: Enterprise component, pattern, and data-visualization guidance. The docs repository was archived on 2026-09-30; this is a pinned snapshot. Text only; images and IBM marks are excluded.

sources.name: Adobe Spectrum
sources.notes: Spectrum 2 component and foundation guidance in JSON. Schema is 1.0.0-draft; pin and validate. Text only; images, fonts, and Adobe marks are excluded.

sources.name: ethereum.org
sources.notes: Web3 design, DEX, transaction, and gas guidance. Content is CC BY 4.0; repository code is MIT. Images and outbound third-party research are excluded.

sources.name: PIE Design System
sources.notes: Food-delivery and marketplace patterns. Apache-2.0; brand palette, logos, food photography, and fonts are excluded.

sources.name: SAP Fiori
sources.notes: SAP Fiori component guidance. Apache-2.0; text only, SAP marks and images excluded.

sources.name: PatternFly
sources.notes: Enterprise dashboard, pattern, and content-design guidance. MIT; images and Red Hat marks are excluded.
